research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tekion is researching cloud-based business applications, focusing on document management, data integration, and automotive retail solutions. Efforts include systems for metadata tag auto-application to posted entries, document parsing and generation, and document sharing with annotations. Additional developments address real-time integration of siloed data, machine-learned validation frameworks, and customer categorization with customized recommendations for automotive retail, highlighting advancements in data processing and user engagement.

overview_description.description:
Tekion is the first and fastest cloud-native platform for automotive retail. Powered by Tekion AI, its platform leverages intelligent automation, real-time insights, and advanced decision support to enhance employee and customer experiences across the dealership ecosystem.  

Positively disrupting auto retail for the first time in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with its revolutionary platform: Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and large automotive enterprises, and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Leveraging cutting-edge technology, big data and AI, Tekion unifies OEMs, dealers, and consumers—streamlining operations and enabling the most modern and efficient automotive retail experiences ever.

about_short_description.short_description: Tekion is the first cloud-native platform for automotive retail, powered by Tekion AI.

product.name: Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC)
product.description: A cloud-based operating platform for automotive dealerships that unifies sales, service, accounting, customer, vehicle, deal, and financial records in one system.

product.name: Tekion AI
product.description: An automotive-focused AI layer that uses dealership data and workflows to provide role-aware insights, recommendations, automation, and task execution.

product.name: Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC)
product.description: A platform for automotive manufacturers and enterprise organizations that connects OEM and retailer operations through unified retail, purchasing, vehicle configuration, financing, and analytics capabilities.

product.name: Automotive Partner Cloud (APC)
product.description: An API and partner ecosystem platform that enables secure data exchange, integrations, and app management between Tekion dealerships and automotive technology providers.

product.name: T1
product.description: A role-aware conversational AI interface that lets dealership users ask questions, receive business insights, and initiate actions across Tekion workflows.

product.name: Dealer Management System (DMS)
product.description: A cloud-based dealership management system for coordinating core automotive retail operations, including transactions, inventory, service, accounting, and financial administration.
